notes.title: Feardemic’s Fear Fest is here to rock your world!
notes.content:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29115981/3e7e277386802bfc38ce01b7d011e2f9aec009c2.jpg

Watch the stream today at 7 pm CET/ 10 am PST and see new trailers for Feardemic’s upcoming games!

Hello, fearfolks!

It’s finally happening, the time has come to rock with us at Feardemic’s Fear Fest 2022! Today (15.03) at 7 pm CET/ 10 am PST you’ll be able to watch exciting new trailers, pick the brains of the developers behind our titles and listen to Hunter Peterson’s silky smooth voice. You can catch the stream at our Youtube and/ or Twitch channel or you can simply navigate to the event website at fearfest.online, where you can also find the countdown to the festivities as well as detailed info on the exact contents of the showcase.

[previewyoutube=He3GI2715Dw;full][/previewyoutube]

Among others, FFF is going to feature news about the icy cold turn-based adventure Terror: Endless Night inspired by the infamous expedition to the Arctic Sea, The vibrant action-filled metroidvania Cosmic: A Journey Among Shadows, and of course one of the most anticipated horror games of 2022, the terrifying and mind-bending Dark Fracture.

See you there, Fearfolks!
